name: Nyrvolas Zylfir P
source:
Prince of the dark elves in Arcandia is (finally) here!

Don't EVER lie to him! He will have an everlasting grudge if you do... Also, he doesn't eat branches. Anyway I forgot his last name... Sorry.

After some months of waiting our dark (literally) prince is here!
